name: Breath
overview: Scripture reveals that breath is the divine gift that imparts life, as God breathed the breath of life into man, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). This breath represents not only physical life but also the sustaining spirit from God, which all living beings possess until death (Genesis 7:22). The breath also carries figurative significance, symbolizing God's power and presence—His anger, judgment, and sustaining Spirit are described as breath or the breath of His nostrils (Job 4:9; Job 15:30; Job 27:3; Job 33:4). Thus, breath in the Bible is both a literal and spiritual expression of life originating from God alone.
